share.line: While share viewing is on, reads the address, title and site icon of the current tab and sends them to your current squad.

token.line: On supported, authorized sites with token data on, reads public token names and icons for sharing or cards; danmaku participation can send public details to the service for display.
token.who: Your squad; the service and public danmaku, hot lists and token details
token.keep: Shares and messages follow their retention; public details stay in service memory, may outlast participation, and clear on restart.

quote.line: Selection reads up to 200 characters, up to 24 characters on each side, and the URL. Quote adds them to a local draft; sending shares them with your squad.

signal.line: When you send a signal, reads the spot you point at; it disappears 5 seconds after teammates see it.

sticky.line: Selection reads up to 200 characters, up to 24 characters on each side, and the URL. Saving a sticky note sends them encrypted to your squad; page notes appear at the same URL.

room.line: With the panel connected and danmaku on, participation sends a token key to the service for a lease. Turning danmaku off stops renewal requests; messages you send stay public.
room.who: The service sees the token, account and device session; counts and messages are public.
room.keep: Participation leases last 40 seconds in memory and renew while active; the latest 1,000 messages per token have no time expiry.

shot.line: When you press the screenshot shortcut or tap Screenshot, reads the image of the current tab; it is sent to your squad only after you select an area and confirm.
shot.who: Your current squad, after you confirm

notify.line: Reads no pages. Shows a desktop alert when your squad has new messages.
notify.who: Chrome and your operating system display the alert; the OS may keep a copy.
notify.keep: Local click records clear on close, click or invalidation; OS notification history may remain.

copy.sharingPrivacy: Share viewing shares only the foreground tab, only with the current squad, and only after you turn it on: a token page shows the token, any other site shows only its name. Page cards, quotes and screenshots you share go into the draft first and are sent only when you confirm. Chat, attachments and viewing status are end-to-end encrypted by the client with Matrix.
copy.lookupPrivacy: Token names and logos are read from the public area of a page only on sites you allowed with Token data on; otherwise a short contract address and a default icon are shown. Receivers check token details locally and may load logos directly from a fixed set of public image hosts; on failure a default icon is shown, never fetched through Palside servers. Image hosts can see the request and connection IP; requests carry no page referrer.
copy.retentionPrivacy: Messages are retained for the period the captain chooses (1, 7, 14 or 30 days, 30 days by default), counted from the original send time; drafts are kept for 7 days and unsent messages for 24 hours. Signing out clears local caches, drafts and decryption keys; older history may be unavailable when you sign in again. Screenshot originals and editing are processed locally without being uploaded.
copy.submissionsPrivacy: Reports contain only content you preview and confirm. The operator can read it; the first view of a private report is audited. Recruiting squads publish their name, description, avatar, captain’s nickname and avatar, level and popularity rank. Onchain addresses, amounts and transaction hashes are public and cannot be deleted. The service stores wallet identity bindings, orders and recovery records. Alchemy and RPC services process signed transactions without receiving private keys. Levels and popularity use activity events and daily aggregates, with network address digests isolated by squad and date, without reading encrypted chat content.
copy.scopePrivacy: Palside is not yet listed in the Chrome Web Store. Website demos use sample data separately from the extension services and do not verify security or readiness for release.
copy.matrixWebsite: Matrix website (opens in a new tab)
copy.matrixTrademark: The Matrix logo is a trademark of the Matrix.org Foundation. Its use does not imply endorsement or affiliation.
copy.encryptedTrail: so only squad members can decrypt.

copy.termsOperator: Operator, contact and governing region: to be announced before public release.
copy.termsService: Palside is a Chrome side-panel extension and service for chatting with a small squad and showing what you choose to share. Chat is end-to-end encrypted; the service relays and stores encrypted messages for the retention period set by each captain.
copy.termsAccount: Your recovery phrase is generated on your device and separately derives your account identity and wallet keys. It controls both your account and PALS funds; Palside cannot recover it. Keep a private backup. Private keys are decrypted and used to sign only on your device; Palside never asks for your phrase. Once enabled, onchain features include transfers, red packets and tips. PALS amounts are shown before payment, and Palside charges no fees. Confirmed onchain transactions cannot be reversed. Deleting your account does not delete onchain records or move your funds.
copy.termsConduct: Do not use Palside for spam, scams, phishing, harassment, illegal content or impersonation. Captains are responsible for recruitment content. Confirmed violations may lead to profile removal, recruitment removal, deletion of public messages or an account ban. Bans last 7 days, 30 days or permanently and immediately sign out every device. Appeals can be sent to {email}.
copy.termsPublic: A recruiting squad's name, description, avatar, captain’s nickname and avatar are visible to anyone on the website and may be indexed by search engines. After recruiting ends, the page is removed; copies kept by search engines disappear on their own schedule.
copy.termsLiability: Palside is provided as is. Token information shown by third-party sites or shared by members is not verified and is not financial advice. Names and icons do not prove a project is genuine. Messages may become unavailable when they expire or when a server fails, and there is no backup.

purpose.question: What is Palside?
purpose.answer: Palside is a side panel extension for desktop Chrome. Sync the tokens you are viewing with your squad, leave signals, danmaku and sticky notes on pages, and discuss it all in an end-to-end encrypted squad chat.

account.question: Do I need to sign up?
account.answer: No email or phone number. Palside generates a recovery phrase on your device, and that phrase is your account. Back it up: if it is lost, no one can recover it.

privacy.question: Can squad members see what I browse?
privacy.answer: Share viewing shares only the token or site name of your current tab when you turn it on. It never automatically shares page content, your screen or page actions. Quotes and screenshots are shared only when you select and send them. Turn Share viewing off any time.

permissions.question: Which browser permissions does Palside need?
permissions.answer: Installing it requests no permissions that trigger a Chrome warning. Share viewing needs “Read your browsing history”; page interaction asks for access only on the sites you add. You can revoke both in Chrome at any time.

encryption.question: How are chats encrypted?
encryption.answer: Squad messages, images and viewing status are end-to-end encrypted on members’ devices. Servers relay ciphertext and cannot read it. A new device shows only messages received after it signs in.

teams.question: How do I join a squad?
teams.answer: Use an invitation link from a captain, or request to join a recruiting squad in Discover squads; you are in once the captain approves. Each squad holds up to 30 members.

pages.privacyLead: What is synced, how data is used and how to stop syncing.
pages.permissionsSummary: No website access at install. Chrome asks for optional permissions the first time you turn on the feature that needs them.
pages.encryptionSummary: Only authorized squad members decrypt chat, attachments and viewing content.
pages.retentionSummary: Messages last 1, 7, 14 or 30 days, as chosen by the captain.
pages.screenshotsSummary: Originals and editing stay on your device. Send only when you confirm.
pages.screenshotsDetail: Cropping and annotation happen on your device. A separate editing window may retain the original in extension background memory. Cancelling, signing out or restarting the background clears it; expired sessions are cleared on later access. Adding to a draft is not sending. A sent image is an ordinary encrypted image message, without the original, layers or cropped-out parts.
pages.metadataDetail: End-to-end encryption does not hide all metadata. The service still processes necessary account, membership, connection time and IP information. Recruiting profiles and reports you choose to submit are separate from private chat.
pages.retentionDetail: Necessary error and anti-abuse records last up to 7 days. Reports last up to 30 days after closure, or 90 days if unresolved. There are no server backups, and copies or screenshots saved by others cannot be forcibly deleted.
pages.publicSummary: Recruiting profiles are public. Reports include only what you confirm.
pages.availabilitySummary: Currently in development and testing; not publicly operated yet.
pages.termsLead: Read these rules before using the service.
pages.serviceSummary: Chat with your squad in Chrome and share what you choose.
pages.accountSummary: Keep your recovery phrase safe. Palside cannot recover your account.
pages.conductSummary: No harassment, impersonation, scams or illegal content.
pages.publicContentSummary: Recruiting profiles you publish can be viewed and indexed by anyone.
pages.liabilitySummary: The service is provided as is; token information is not investment advice.

pages.dataSummary: Each item leaves your device only for the feature it serves.
pages.dataMessages: Squad messages are encrypted on your device and the service stores only ciphertext; danmaku is public.
pages.dataBrowsing: Only while Share viewing is on, the token or site name of your foreground tab is sent encrypted to your squad. No history is kept.
pages.dataPage: Text you quote or pin as a sticky note, screenshots you confirm sending, and the public token name and icon on token pages.
pages.dataActions: When you send a signal, the page element you point at and its relative position are sent encrypted to your squad. Keystrokes and scrolling are never recorded.
pages.dataTransactions: Your wallet’s public address, transfer, red packet and tip orders, and their onchain status. Onchain records are public and cannot be deleted.
pages.dataNetwork: The service processes your connection IP; anti-abuse records last up to 7 days.
pages.danmakuSummary: Danmaku is public and not encrypted.
pages.danmakuDetail: Everyone watching the same token can see your danmaku, nickname and avatar. The service stores the text, author and token, keeping the latest 1,000 per token. Sentiment results are public. The service knows which tokens’ danmaku you join, but never receives page URLs or builds a browsing history.
pages.thirdPartiesSummary: Data is used only to provide the features on this page.
pages.thirdPartiesDetail: Palside does not sell user data, use it for advertising, or use it to determine creditworthiness or for lending. Squad chat runs on a Matrix service operated by Palside.
pages.thirdPartiesChain: Process the PALS transactions you sign and public onchain information. They never receive private keys.
pages.thirdPartiesImages: Receivers may load token icons directly from a fixed set of public image hosts, which can see the image request and connection IP.
pages.limitedUse: The use of information received from Chrome APIs will adhere to the Chrome Web Store User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
pages.choicesSummary: Take back permissions or clear local data anytime.
pages.choicesDetail: Use Settings › Privacy & data to take back permissions and clear local caches. Deleting your account removes your profile and associations, except records already onchain. Palside is not directed to anyone under 18. For privacy questions, contact palside@pm.me.
